corpora.preprocessing: DuckDB 1.5.4 reads the text column in Parquet row order; CRLF and CR normalize to LF; all 4358 rows join with one LF

projection.selection: first 16 rows in Parquet row order
projection.target_extraction: final answer token after the terminal #### marker, with commas removed

profiles.smoke: first short, multi-turn, and long-context cases; at least 128 long-context tokens; 8 greedy outputs on the short case
profiles.full: all pinned prompts; at least 256 tokens per long-context case; 256 greedy outputs on each designated prompt
profiles.extended_soak: set XRT_REAL_MOE_QUALITY_LONG_TOKENS to 384, 512, or 4096; these lengths are diagnostic and are not part of the passing admission profile

implementation_parity_harness.instrumentation: bounded per-token/per-layer logical expert IDs plus selected/excluded boundary diagnostics; compiled out unless moe-route-trace is enabled; batch traces are normalized by per-layer token occurrence

perplexity_harness.tokenization: verify the complete derived-file SHA-256, then encode newline-terminated segments in order until max_tokens is satisfied
perplexity_harness.sampling: fixed non-overlapping window endpoints using the final-logit row
perplexity_harness.admission_activation_mode: XRT_CPU_FLOAT_ACTIVATION_REFERENCE=1 on CPU and the hybrid CPU tier
split_modes: CUDA-only with required matching CPU reference scalar
